description: Source code for a Kivy Video widget class, including implementation details, properties, methods, and a sample app.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: A Kivy widget class for displaying and controlling video playback, supporting properties like source, volume, state, and preview.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Video widget, sets up source binding, and triggers video load if source is provided.

methods.name: texture_update
methods.description: Updates the widget's texture with either the preview image or the video source.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the video based on a percentage of total duration.

methods.name: _do_video_load
methods.description: Loads the video using CoreVideo, sets properties, and starts playback if needed.

methods.name: on_state
methods.description: Handles changes to the playback state ('play', 'pause', 'stop').

methods.name: _on_video_frame
methods.description: Updates duration, position, and texture when a new video frame is available.

methods.name: _on_eos
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream event, stops video and sets eos property.

methods.name: _on_load
methods.description: Sets loaded property to True when video is loaded.

methods.name: on_volume
methods.description: Adjusts the volume of the video playback.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Unloads the video and stops playback.
